resources.string: You can\'t find any of them.
Shelfie reads the text inside every screenshot so you can just search for what you remember.
Shelfie reads the text in your screenshots so you can search them. That reading happens here, on this device.

Your screenshots, and the text found inside them, stay on this phone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is shared, and no one else can see them. There is no account and no sign-up.\n\nShelfie does not even have permission to use the internet, so it cannot send anything anywhere.
Shelfie needs to see your screenshots
That\'s the whole job. With access, your newest screenshots become searchable in about ten seconds.
Picking manually works too — search, categories and actions all behave the same. You just choose which screenshots Shelfie sees.
